text: {"term":"Leverage Ratio","formula":"Leverage Ratio = (Total Liabilities − S) ÷ (Tangible Net Worth + S), where S = the amount of Subordinated Debt applied under Section 6.12(c), up to an aggregate of US$15,000,000. The same S is added to the denominator and deducted from the numerator. All figures are for the Parent and its consolidated Subsidiaries as of the date of determination. Covenant: the ratio at the end of each fiscal quarter of the Parent must not exceed 6.00 to 1.00. The Subordinated Debt adjustment applies only to the Leverage Ratio. It does not apply to the stand-alone Tangible Net Worth covenant in Section 6.12(a), which uses unadjusted Tangible Net Worth of at least US$40,000,000. GAPS: the provided pages do not define 'Total Liabilities', 'Tangible Net Worth' or 'Subordinated Debt'. The page 11 definitions run alphabetically from 'Lender' to 'Payment Date' and do not reach the S or T entries. The components therefore cannot be broken down further from these documents. The text also does not state whether S is mandatory at the lower of actual Subordinated Debt and US$15,000,000, or elective. It says only 'up to US$15,000,000 shall be added'.","parts":[{"clause":"Section 1.1 (page 11) – definition of \"Leverage Ratio\"","quote":"\"Leverage Ratio\" means, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) Total Liabilities to (b) Tangible Net Worth, in each case as adjusted under Section 6.12(c) and determined for the Parent and its consolidated Subsidiaries."},{"clause":"Section 6.12(c) – Treatment of Subordinated Debt (cross-referenced adjustment)","quote":"Solely for the purpose of calculating the Leverage Ratio under paragraph (b) above, and not for the purpose of paragraph (a) above, (i) Subordinated Debt in an aggregate amount of up to US$15,000,000 shall be added to Tangible Net Worth, and (ii) the same amount of Subordinated Debt shall be deducted from Total Liabilities."},{"clause":"Section 6.12(b) – Maximum Leverage Ratio (test level and timing)","quote":"The Leverage Ratio at the end of each fiscal quarter of the Parent does not exceed 6.00 to 1.00."},{"clause":"Section 6.12(a) – Minimum Tangible Net Worth (carve-out: unadjusted TNW used here)","quote":"Tangible Net Worth at the end of each fiscal quarter of the Parent is not less than US$40,000,000."},{"clause":"Section 1.1 (page 11) – definition of \"Parent\" (entity whose consolidated figures are used)","quote":"\"Parent\" means Bramble Auto Finance LLC, a Delaware limited liability company."},{"clause":"Exhibit C – Form of Compliance Certificate (reporting format)","quote":"Leverage Ratio: ______ to 1.00"}]}
